title: A theory of inductive node-level generalization from a single large graph
abstract: arXiv:2611.30937v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In Graph Machine Learning (GML), the notion of generalization fundamentally varies depending on the task level and the properties of the dataset. For instance, graph-level tasks fit into the traditional ML framework of i.i.d. samples, with relatively small graphs. On the contrary, node-level tasks involve dependent nodes, often in a few large graphs. Existing studies often consider the transductive settings, where training and test data co-exist in the same graph, or, for inductive learning, try to recover some kind of probabilistic ``independence'', e.g. by still assuming a large number of independent graphs or subgraphs.   In this work, we develop a novel framework to express the generalization capabilities of Graph ML algorithms for inductive node-level tasks when learning from a single large graph, taking inspiration from the literature on GNN transferability. translated_title: 从单个大图进行归纳式节点级泛化的理论
translated_abstract: 在图机器学习（GML）中，泛化的概念根据任务层级和数据集属性有着根本的不同。例如，图级任务符合传统的独立同分布样本的机器学习框架，通常涉及相对较小的图。相反，节点级任务涉及相互依赖的节点，且往往只存在于少数几个大图中。现有研究通常考虑直推式设置，即训练数据和测试数据共存于同一个图中；或者对于归纳学习，试图恢复某种概率意义上的“独立性”，例如仍然假设存在大量独立的图或子图。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个新颖的框架，用于表达图机器学习算法在从单个大图学习时执行归纳式节点级任务的泛化能力，该框架借鉴了图神经网络可迁移性方面的文献。特别是，我们通过重新审视……强调了其与经典机器学习的相似之处。
tldr: 本文提出了一个新理论框架，用于刻画图机器学习算法在仅从单个大图学习时进行归纳式节点级任务的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel theoretical framework to characterize the generalization capabilities of Graph ML algorithms for inductive node-level tasks when learning from a single large graph.
